capture_002.scope: Captured active receiver with previous successfully decoded frame, not a stop/CRC fault. General controller HOLD label is preserved verbatim in original receipt.

fix.problem: A completed I2C transfer retained software slot DONE until core0 consumed its reply, denying the audio GPIO lease after the bus was already physically idle.
fix.change: PINS_DONE retains the completed reply while audio owns physical pins. Atomic consume and return preserve both resources in either order. Queued, working, filling and active pin ownership remain exclusive.
fix.host_regressions: 128 audio loans during a retained reply; both completion orders; 10000 concurrent I2C replies with exact data, no lost result or premature new request. Actual ARM admission, production reply copy and service paths.
fix.hardware_causality: Consistent with observed12752us wait; no claim it is the sole hardware starvation cause.
fix.new_first_fault_diagnostic: Own-SM FDEBUG cleared once per block; first fault retains time/phase/PIO FIFO flags+levels/DMAremaining/GPIO/SM PC/index. GPIO and protocol timing unchanged.
fix.old_stop_fault: Unresolved: short003 -45 remains failed. Capture002 had no NRZ errors; does not disprove intermittent framing fault.
